issues.description: The declaration and the definition of Bitmap24::resize_buffer use different parameter types. In the header the method is declared with parameters of type long (void resize_buffer(long i_width, long i_height)), while the implementation defines it with int parameters (void Bitmap24::resize_buffer(int i_width, int i_height)). This mismatch will cause a linker/type error when compiling the C++ example_program and will block students from building or testing the provided code.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the declaration and definition match. Either change the header declaration to use int (void resize_buffer(int i_width, int i_height)) or change the implementation to use long (void Bitmap24::resize_buffer(long i_width, long i_height)). Prefer choosing the type consistent with the rest of the class and other callers (int is used elsewhere), then update both header and implementation accordingly.
